correctness.rationale: The exact six quintics from Kabat–Strycharz-Szemberg are base-point free by their Lemma 5, hence induce P²→P⁵ with pullback O(5). Any positive-dimensional fiber contains a curve, impossible since O(5) has positive degree on every curve; the morphism is finite onto its image. Direct substitution at [1:2:1] yields [4:12:−4:39:0:−35]. In chart C=1 the cross equations factor as 4(A−1)(A⁴+A³+6A²+A+1), 4(15A³−B⁵+5B²−3), 5(39A³−4B³−7), −20B²(A−1)(A²+A+1); when A≠1 the other equations contradict B=0 or A³=1, while A=1 forces B²=4,B³=8, hence B=2. Jacobian of normalized first and third equations at that point is −480, verifying a reduced singleton fiber. Finite degree-one map from normal P² gives normalization, and (5L)^2=degree(X)=25. Independently recomputed all five exact cross-polynomial factorisations and the Jacobian with SymPy, not just accepted VERIFY_OK.
